x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: A tool to keep files in a source branch in sync with a target branch

options.name: --token
options.description: GitLab access token. Prefer the GitLab_OAuthToken environment variable; use this only for ad-hoc runs, since it can be visible in shell history and process listings.

options.name: --host-url
options.description: GitLab instance base URL (defaults to https://gitlab.com)

arguments.name: FILENAME
arguments.description: Path to the GitLabSync YAML configuration file [default: gitlabsync.yaml]
